Seventh development release of 0.19.0: blades and modules count in rack cooling, the Routing tab loads with circuits cabled at both ends, every cable end keeps its address, band alignment and role badges on photos.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.19.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.19.0 right.

> [!NOTE]
> **Behaviour changes:**
> - **Blades and modules follow the rack's cooling.** Installing a liquid, hybrid or immersion blade or module into a device in a rack that can't cool it is refused, as placing such a device directly is; a blade's heat counts in its chassis' rack. Existing installs are not changed - they show under **Mismatched cooling**.

### Topology

- **Band alignment.** Right-click a band for **Align**: Auto, Left, Center or Right, per line when the band wraps. Saved with the view.
- **Role badge on photos.** A device drawn as its photo shows its role badge next to its name, by default and in exports; the legend lists only the role colours the map shows.
- **Every cable end keeps its address.** With labels on, an end's addresses may use its whole half of the cable and subnet boxes move around them; when room is short IPv6 goes before IPv4.

### Fixed

- #468 - Fixes the SBOM export naming a site the user can't view.
- #469 - Fixes blades in device bays and installed modules escaping the rack cooling rule, heat load and the mismatched-cooling count.
- #470 - Fixes the Jobs page content area being unreachable by keyboard; a list page's content area is now a focusable region.
- **The Routing tab** failed to load (500) when a circuit was cabled to a device at both ends.
- **Container images:** the frontend image build failed when the BuildKit image could not be pulled from the mirror; the setup now retries once.
